name: bxss-vault
description: A hardened, Cloudflare-native blind XSS callback vault.

scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

AUTH_PEPPER.description: 32 random bytes encoded as base64url. Back this up; it protects sessions, collector tokens, and recovery codes.

DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 32 random bytes encoded as base64url. Back this up offline; losing it makes stored captures unreadable.

BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: A one-time 32-byte base64url token used only to register the first owner passkey.
